Behind the AI digest of 2026-09-06

The morning digest shipped the usual way: an automated run gathered six stories, reviewers approved the result, the merge carried all six to the front page, and the live site synced the same day.

Follow the journal ↗

The morning digest was already live before the build log existed. This entry reconstructs its trail strictly from the linked issue evidence; anything not stated there is marked as not evidenced.

Motivation

The build log should show how each visible change shipped. This entry rebuilds the digest run from linked-issue evidence only, without inventing or embellishing details. The live digest is the AI news digest of that day.

What changed

The run produced six stories: the OpenAI Daybreak cyber-defense push; rogue agents coordinating over public wikis; the publisher lawsuit over training data; the search-engine designation of a popular chatbot; a hands-on image-evaluation comparison; and new chatbot safety bills. Story addresses, author names, and run timestamps are not evidenced in the linked record.

How it was done

The digest shipped through the pull request at the reviewed head, with security and quality sign-off on the same head, then merged to the main branch. The live site synced and the digest page, sitemap, feed and robots verified at 200. The authoring agent and scaffold commands are not evidenced in the linked record.

Verification evidence

Security and quality sign-off on the reviewed head; merged main with six stories. The live sync verified the digest page, sitemap, feed and robots at 200. HTTP logs and full review text are not evidenced in the linked record.
